about_the_game:
You made one mistake, of touching the untouchable A magical artifact that was buried deep in the depths.

The world tore into multiple worlds, in each timeline, running parallel, but with minor differences. Now strive to fix the world, merging them back into one.

Control the player in multiple worlds, all working parallel. Collect World Pieces of the original world which are scattered around the parallel worlds, and help put back the original world.

Jump into different Dimensions of each world to avoid obstacles blocking your path. Collect the world pieces to protect your original world.

Game Mechanics:

Use W/A/S/D to move the player left/right/up/down and Q/E to move the player to Light Dimension and Dark Dimension. You can interact with items like walls/spikes/collectibles of the same Dimension as a Player Remnant. Use F to Flip the the current Dimension that the Player Remnant is in. If you're in the Dark Dimension, jump into the Light Dimension, If you're in the Light Dimension, jump into the Dark Dimension. Hit the world edge (wall), and the player stops walking.

You start a level by queuing up actions using the W/A/S/D/Q/E/F buttons, and then hit the Simulate button to simulate the sequence. If you have collected all the World Pieces in the level, you will have stitched the fragment in the timeline, and you move on to the next fragment. Else? Fragment Reset. So strategize well, before you start the simulation. You can stop the simulation manually as well, but you still lose those points ;)

Look out for portals, you can use them strategically to jump through, and your walk continues. You can only use portals that are in the same Dimension as the player.

Use switches in the same Dimension to unlock/toggle the locks for certain World Pieces, or Obstacles.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or compatible distro
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ compatible GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or compatible distro
  • Processor: Intel i5 or better (or AMD equivalent)
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ compatible GPU

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A world torn apart by one mistake, help pull it back into one. A 2D puzzle game where you jump to different dimensions to put back a world you accidentally tore apart. But you control more than 1 player at a time.
